title: Avocado Chocolate Mousse
instructions: Place the 150g of avocado flesh into a blender or food processor.
Add 20g of cocoa powder, 30g of erythritol, 30ml of almond milk, and 2g of vanilla extract.
Blend on high speed until the mixture is completely smooth and creamy.
Taste and add more erythritol if a sweeter taste is desired.
Divide the mousse into two small bowls and chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving.

title: Raspberry Almond Mug Cake
instructions: In a microwave-safe mug, whisk together 35g of almond flour, 15g of erythritol, and 2g of baking powder.
Stir in 1 egg white and 10ml of rapeseed oil until a smooth batter forms.
Gently fold in 20g of frozen raspberries.
Microwave on high for 60–90 seconds (time varies by microwave) until the cake is firm to the touch.
Let cool for 1 minute before eating directly from the mug.

title: Dark Chocolate Walnut Clusters
instructions: Preheat oven to 160°C and toast 100g of walnuts on a tray for 5–7 minutes until fragrant.
Break 25g of dark chocolate into small pieces and melt in a heat-proof bowl over simmering water (or in short bursts in the microwave).
Line a plate with parchment paper.
Dip each walnut half into the melted chocolate or drizzle the chocolate over small clusters of walnuts on the paper.
Sprinkle with a tiny pinch of sea salt.
Place in the refrigerator for 20 minutes until the chocolate is set. One portion is roughly 30g.

title: Vanilla Berry Chia Pudding
instructions: In a glass jar or bowl, whisk together 40g of chia seeds, 250ml of almond milk, 20g of erythritol, and 2g of vanilla extract.
Stir well, then let sit for 10 minutes and stir again to prevent clumping.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or ideally overnight.
Before serving, stir the pudding again and divide into two portions.
Top each bowl with 20g of fresh or thawed mixed berries.

title: Lemon Poppy Seed Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C and line a muffin tin with 6 liners.
In a bowl, combine 150g of almond flour, 30g of erythritol, 10g of poppy seeds, lemon zest, and 5g of baking powder.
Add 2 egg whites, 20ml of rapeseed oil, and the juice of half the lemon.
Mix until a uniform batter forms, then divide into the 6 muffin liners.
Bake for 18–22 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool completely before serving.

title: Almond & Berry Crumble
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°C.
Place 120g of frozen berries in a small oven-proof dish.
In a small bowl, mix 40g of almond flour, 15g of chopped walnuts, 10g of erythritol, 1g of cinnamon, and 10ml of rapeseed oil until it looks like coarse sand.
Sprinkle the crumble mixture evenly over the berries.
Bake for 15–20 minutes until the berries are bubbling and the topping is golden brown.
Serve warm.

title: Cocoa-Walnut Truffles
instructions: Place 60g of walnuts in a food processor and pulse until they are finely ground (but not turned into butter).
Add 10g of cocoa powder, 15g of powdered erythritol, and 1g of vanilla extract.
Pulse again while adding 5ml of water until the mixture clumps together.
Roll the mixture into 6 small balls using your hands.
Optional: Roll the balls in a little extra cocoa powder.
Chill in the fridge for 20 minutes to firm up. One portion is 3 truffles.

title: Golden Flax & Sunflower Bread
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a small loaf tin with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, whisk 5 egg whites until frothy but not stiff.
Stir in 200g of ground flaxseeds, 50g of sunflower seeds, 10g of baking powder, and 3g of salt.
Add 15ml of rapeseed oil and 100ml of warm water, mixing until a thick dough forms.
Transfer the dough to the tin and smooth the top with a wet spatula.
Bake for 45–50 minutes until the loaf sounds hollow when tapped on the bottom.
Allow to cool completely before slicing into 10 even pieces.

title: Rosemary Olive Oil Focaccia
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°C and line a small square baking dish with parchment.
Combine 200g of almond flour and 5g of baking powder in a bowl.
Fold in 2 egg whites and 15ml of the olive oil until a dough forms.
Press the dough into the dish until it is about 1.5cm thick.
Use your fingers to poke dimples into the surface, then drizzle the remaining 15ml of olive oil over the top.
Sprinkle with 5g of rosemary and 2g of sea salt.
Bake for 15–18 minutes until the edges are golden brown. Slice into 6 squares.

title: Savory Walnut Zucchini Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C and line a loaf tin.
Ensure the 250g of grated zucchini is squeezed very dry using a cloth.
In a bowl, mix the zucchini with 150g almond flour, 50g chopped walnuts, baking powder, and oregano.
Add 3 egg whites and 20ml of rapeseed oil, stirring until well combined.
Pour into the loaf tin and bake for 40 minutes or until a skewer comes out clean.
Let cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack. Slice into 8 portions.

title: 3-Ingredient Seeded Crackers
instructions: In a bowl, mix 50g sunflower seeds, 50g pumpkin seeds, 20g chia seeds, and 2g salt.
Add 100ml of water and stir. Let sit for 15 minutes until the chia seeds absorb the water and form a gel.
Preheat oven to 150°C.
Spread the mixture very thinly onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 45 minutes, then remove and flip the whole sheet over. Peel off the paper.
Bake for another 15 minutes until completely crisp. Break into 4 large portions once cooled.

title: Spinach & Almond Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C and grease a 6-slot muffin tin.
Mix 150g almond flour, 100g chopped spinach, 5g baking powder, and garlic powder in a bowl.
Add 2 egg whites and 20ml of rapeseed oil.
Divide the batter evenly into the 6 muffin slots.
Bake for 20–22 minutes until firm to the touch.
These can be eaten warm or cold.

title: Almond Soft Tortilla Wraps
instructions: Mix 120g almond flour, 15g psyllium husk, and 2g salt in a bowl.
Add 5ml of rapeseed oil and 120ml of boiling water. Stir immediately until a dough forms.
Let the dough rest for 5 minutes to firm up.
Divide the dough into 4 balls. Roll each ball out between two sheets of parchment paper until very thin.
Cook in a dry, non-stick pan over medium-high heat for 1 minute per side.
Keep covered with a towel to stay soft until serving.

title: Pumpkin Seed Flatbread
instructions: In a small bowl, mix 80g ground pumpkin seeds, 1 egg white, garlic powder, and 30ml water.
Heat 10ml of olive oil in a small non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour in the mixture and spread it out into a circle.
Cook for 3–4 minutes until the bottom is set and golden, then flip carefully.
Cook for another 2 minutes. Slice into halves and serve.

title: Herb-Crusted Baked Cod
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C and line a tray with baking paper.
In a small bowl, mix 40g of almond flour, 5g of parsley, lemon zest, and 5ml of olive oil to create a crumbly paste.
Place the 300g of cod fillets on the tray and brush with the remaining 10ml of olive oil and lemon juice.
Press the almond mixture firmly onto the top of each fillet.
Bake for 12–15 minutes until the fish is opaque and the crust is golden.
Serve alongside 200g of steamed green beans.

title: Turkey & Zucchini Stir-fry
instructions: Heat 15ml of rapeseed oil in a large wok or pan over high heat.
Add 300g of ground turkey and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spatula.
Stir in 20g of ginger and 10g of garlic, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add 400g of zucchini and 20ml of soy sauce.
Stir-fry for 3–4 minutes until the zucchini is tender but still has a bite.
Divide into two bowls and serve immediately.

title: Walnut-Crusted Tofu Steaks
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Toss 300g of cauliflower florets with 10ml of olive oil, salt, and paprika on a baking sheet.
Press 40g of crushed walnuts onto the sides of the tofu steaks.
Place tofu on the sheet with the cauliflower and drizzle the remaining 10ml of olive oil over the tofu.
Bake for 20 minutes, flipping the cauliflower halfway through.
Serve the crispy tofu steaks with the roasted cauliflower.

title: Mediterranean Chicken Salad
instructions: Season 250g of chicken breast with salt and pepper, then grill or pan-fry until fully cooked.
Slice the cooked chicken into strips.
In a large bowl, combine 50g of greens, 150g of cucumber, and 100g of sliced avocado.
Whisk 20ml of olive oil with 10ml of lemon juice to create the dressing.
Add the chicken to the bowl, pour over the dressing, and toss gently to combine.
Divide between two plates.

title: Mushroom Cauliflower Risotto
instructions: Heat 15ml of olive oil in a deep pan over medium heat.
Sauté 50g of onion and 200g of mushrooms for 8 minutes until the moisture has evaporated and they are browned.
Add 500g of riced cauliflower and 5g of thyme, stirring for 2 minutes.
Pour in 100ml of broth and simmer uncovered for 5–7 minutes until the liquid is absorbed and the cauliflower is tender.
Season with salt and pepper and serve warm.

title: Lemon Garlic Baked Herring
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Place 250g of fresh herring fillets in a baking dish.
Drizzle with 10ml of rapeseed oil and scatter garlic slices and lemon rounds over the fish.
Bake for 12–15 minutes until the fish flakes easily with a fork.
Serve each portion with 150g of steamed broccoli.

title: Lean Beef & Broccoli Stir-fry
ingredients: 250g lean beef steak (e.g., sirloin, fat trimmed)
instructions: Thinly slice 250g of lean beef across the grain.
Heat 10ml of rapeseed oil in a pan over high heat.
Flash-fry the beef for 2–3 minutes until just browned, then remove from the pan.
Add 300g of broccoli and a splash of water, covering the pan for 2 minutes to steam-fry.
Return the beef to the pan, add 15ml of soy sauce and 10g of ginger.
Toss for 1 minute, garnish with 5g of sesame seeds, and serve.

title: Smoked Mackerel & Avocado Mash
instructions: Flake the 120g of smoked mackerel into a bowl, ensuring all small bones are removed.
Add the 100g of avocado and 10ml of lemon juice to the bowl.
Mash the mixture together with a fork until it reaches a chunky paste consistency.
Season with plenty of black pepper (salt is usually unnecessary due to the smoked fish).
Arrange the 200g of thick cucumber slices on a plate.
Top each cucumber slice with a generous spoonful of the mackerel mash and serve.

title: Flaxseed & Walnut N'oats
instructions: Pour 200ml of unsweetened almond milk into a small saucepan over medium heat.
Whisk in 40g of ground flaxseeds and 2g of cinnamon.
Stir constantly for 3–5 minutes until the mixture thickens to a porridge-like consistency.
Pour the mixture into a bowl and top with 20g of crushed walnuts.
Add 30g of frozen raspberries on top and allow them to thaw slightly from the heat of the oats before eating.

title: Tofu Scramble with Spinach
instructions: Heat 15ml of olive oil in a large non-stick frying pan over medium heat.
Crumble the 360g of tofu directly into the pan using your hands or a fork.
Add 5g of turmeric and 10ml of soy sauce, stirring well to ensure the tofu is evenly colored yellow.
Cook for 5 minutes, then add 100g of fresh spinach and 50g of halved cherry tomatoes.
Sauté for another 2–3 minutes until the spinach has wilted and the tomatoes are soft.
Divide into two portions and serve immediately.

title: Chia & Berry Skyr Bowl
instructions: In a small bowl, mix 20g of chia seeds with 50ml of water and let sit for 5 minutes to bloom.
Add 150g of Skyr natural yogurt to the chia mixture and stir thoroughly.
Top the bowl with 40g of frozen blueberries.
Sprinkle 5g of pumpkin seeds over the top for added texture and healthy fats.
Serve immediately or refrigerate for 30 minutes for a thicker consistency.

title: Almond Savory Pancakes
instructions: In a mixing bowl, whisk together 100g of almond flour, 3 egg whites, 50ml of water, and 2g of salt until a smooth batter forms.
Stir in 5g of finely chopped fresh chives.
Heat 10ml of rapeseed oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Pour the batter into the pan to form 4 small pancakes.
Cook for 3–4 minutes on the first side until bubbles form on the surface, then flip carefully.
Cook for another 2 minutes until golden brown and serve warm.

title: Zucchini Walnut Muffins
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a muffin tin with 4 liners.
Grate 200g of zucchini and use a clean kitchen towel to squeeze out as much water as possible.
In a large bowl, combine the dry zucchini, 150g almond flour, 40g walnuts, and 5g baking powder.
Add 2 egg whites and 15ml of rapeseed oil, mixing until a thick batter forms.
Divide the batter evenly among the 4 muffin liners.
Bake for 20–25 minutes until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Allow to cool before serving; one portion is one large muffin.

title: Smoked Salmon Roll-ups
instructions: Trim the woody ends off 200g of green asparagus spears.
Bring a small pot of water to a boil and blanch the asparagus for 3 minutes until tender-crisp, then plunge into cold water.
Dry the asparagus thoroughly and drizzle with 10ml of olive oil and 5ml of lemon juice.
Lay out 150g of smoked salmon slices and wrap them tightly around bundles of 3–4 asparagus spears.
Arrange the roll-ups on a plate and sprinkle with 5g of sesame seeds.
Serve chilled as a light, high-protein breakfast.

title: Tuna Potato Bowl
instructions: Place 400g of diced potatoes in a pot of salted water and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat and simmer the potatoes for 12–15 minutes until fork-tender, then drain thoroughly.
In a bowl, combine 150g of yogurt, 10g of mustard, and 5ml of lemon juice to form the dressing.
Add the drained 120g of tuna into the bowl and mix gently to combine.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Divide the cooked potatoes evenly into two bowls and top with the tuna mixture.
Sprinkle with fresh parsley if using and serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Spiced Bean Bowl
instructions: Heat 15ml of olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add 100g of chopped onion and sauté for 5–7 minutes until soft and lightly golden.
Add 10g of minced garlic, paprika, and cumin, and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in 240g of drained and rinsed beans and cook for 5–7 minutes until heated through.
Season the mixture with salt, black pepper, and a small amount of vinegar or lemon juice to brighten the flavor.
Prepare rice separately by cooking 60g of uncooked rice according to package instructions until tender.
Divide the cooked rice evenly into two bowls and top with the spiced bean mixture.
Mix lightly before serving.

title: Oats Yogurt Fruit Bowl
instructions: Divide the oats evenly into two serving bowls.
Add 150g of yogurt to each bowl and stir slightly.
Chop your chosen fruit and layer it evenly across both servings.
Drizzle with honey if desired and serve immediately.

title: Scrambled Eggs with Toast
instructions: Whisk the eggs in a bowl with the milk, salt, and pepper until combined.
Heat butter or oil in a non-stick pan over low-medium heat.
Pour in the egg mixture and cook gently, stirring constantly for a creamy texture.
Toast the bread until golden and serve the eggs immediately on top.

title: Yogurt Oats Bowl
instructions: Divide the yogurt evenly between two bowls.
Stir 40g of oats into each portion of yogurt.
Slice your fruit and arrange it on top of the mixture.
Add a dollop of peanut butter to each bowl and mix before eating.

title: Smoky Tofu & Lentil Bolognese
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Press the tofu to remove excess moisture, then crumble into small pieces.
Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onion, carrot, and celery and cook for 5–7 minutes until softened.
Add garlic, smoked paprika, oregano, thyme, and chili flakes (if using). Cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the crumbled tofu and cook for about 5 minutes until lightly browned.
Stir in lentils, chopped tomatoes, tomato paste, soy sauce, and vegetable stock.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 20–30 minutes until lentils are tender and the sauce thickens. Add more stock if needed.
Meanwhile, cook the whole grain spaghetti according to package instructions.
Stir balsamic vinegar into the sauce (optional) and season with salt and pepper.
Serve the bolognese over the cooked whole grain spaghetti.

title: Turkey Burgers
instructions: In a large bowl, combine turkey mince, egg, breadcrumbs, and spices.
Mix thoroughly and shape into 4 equal-sized patties.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat and cook for 6-7 minutes per side.
Ensure the center is cooked through before serving in a bun or wrap.

title: Med. Chicken Bake
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (390°F).
Place chicken and vegetables on a large baking tray.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle generously with oregano and salt.
Toss well and bake for 25-30 minutes until the chicken is golden and veg is tender.

title: Veggie Burger
instructions: Pulse chickpeas, onion, and parsley in a food processor until chunky (not a paste).
Stir in the cumin and flour to bind the mixture.
Form into 4 patties and chill in the fridge for 20 minutes to firm up.
Fry in a lightly oiled pan for 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown.

title: Turkey Burger Wrap
instructions: Heat the tortilla slightly in a dry pan for 30 seconds.
Place the cooked turkey patty in the center.
Top with salad and tomato, then fold the sides in to create a wrap.
Slice in half and serve immediately.

title: Veggie Burger Wrap
instructions: Toss the baby spinach with a squeeze of lemon juice.
Lay the spinach on a flat tortilla and place the veggie patty on top.
Fold firmly and toast for 1 minute in a pan to seal the edges.
Serve with extra spinach on the side.

title: Mushroom & Spinach Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta in salted boiling water until al dente.
While pasta cooks, sauté mushrooms and garlic in a pan until browned.
Add spinach and allow to wilt for 1 minute.
Pour in the light cream, bring to a simmer, and toss in the cooked pasta.

title: Fillet Steak & Potatoes
instructions: Boil potato cubes for 10 minutes, then pan-fry until crispy.
Season steak heavily with salt and pepper.
Sear steak in a hot pan for 3-4 minutes per side (medium-rare).
Steam asparagus for 3 minutes and serve alongside the steak and potatoes.

title: Fillet Steak & Mushrooms
instructions: Sear seasoned steak in a hot pan to your liking, then remove and rest.
In the same pan, melt butter and add mushrooms and thyme.
Sauté mushrooms until they soak up the steak juices and turn golden.
Serve the steak topped with the buttery mushrooms.

title: Chicken & Broccoli Pasta
instructions: Boil pasta; add broccoli florets for the last 3 minutes of cooking.
Dice and pan-fry chicken until fully cooked.
Drain pasta/broccoli, reserving a splash of water.
Stir in chicken and cream cheese, using reserved water to create a sauce.

title: Fluffy Buns
instructions: Preheat oven to 175°C (350°F).
Whisk dry ingredients, then add egg whites and boiling water.
Beat for 30 seconds until a dough forms. Shape into 6 buns.
Bake for 50-60 minutes. The buns should feel light and hollow when tapped.

title: Bread Rolls
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl until a sticky dough forms.
Divide into 4 portions and roll into balls with wet hands.
Bake at 180°C (360°F) for 20-25 minutes until golden.
Allow to cool completely before slicing.

title: Sandwich Bread
instructions: Combine flour, yeast, and water. Knead for 10 minutes until smooth.
Place in a bowl, cover, and let rise for 1 hour until doubled in size.
Shape into a loaf tin and let rise for another 30 minutes.
Bake at 200°C for 30-35 minutes until the bottom sounds hollow.

title: Protein Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C. Grease a square baking tin.
Whisk mashed avocado and eggs until creamy.
Fold in protein powder and cocoa until fully incorporated.
Bake for 18-20 minutes. They should be slightly fudgy in the center.

title: Bread & Butter Pudding
instructions: Cut bread into triangles and layer in a baking dish with sultanas.
Whisk eggs, milk, and cinnamon. Pour over the bread.
Let soak for 15 minutes.
Bake at 180°C for 30-35 minutes until set and slightly crisp on top.

title: Yogurt Cheesecake
instructions: Whisk yogurt, eggs, cornstarch, and sweetener until completely smooth.
Pour into a parchment-lined round tin.
Bake at 160°C for 45-50 minutes. The center should have a slight jiggle.
Chill in the fridge for at least 4 hours (ideally overnight) before serving.

title: Banana Choc Oat Cake
instructions: Mash bananas until smooth, then stir in oats and cocoa powder.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Press into a loaf tin and bake at 180°C for 25-30 minutes.
This cake is dense and moist—let it cool before slicing.

title: Banana Cocoa Cake
instructions: Blend bananas until liquid.
Stir in oat flour and cocoa powder until a smooth batter forms.
Pour into a small cake tin and bake at 180°C for 25 minutes.
Serve as is or with a dollop of yogurt.

title: Chocolate Bean Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 170°C.
Blend rinsed black beans and eggs in a food processor until completely smooth.
Pulse in cocoa powder and sweetener.
Bake in a small tin for 40 minutes. The beans provide a rich, flourless texture.

title: Apple Cinnamon Cake
instructions: Grate the apples (skins on for fiber).
Mix with oat bran, eggs, and cinnamon until well combined.
Let the mixture sit for 10 minutes so the oats can absorb the apple juice.
Bake at 180°C for 30 minutes until the top is firm.
